summary_en: 100,000 shares (1.35% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-18 at closing price of ¥1,098/share (¥109.8M upper limit). Settlement same-day after 08:45 JST execution window closes. Order valid for that time window only.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 17 August 2026, IC Co., Ltd.'s board of directors resolved to acquire up to 100,000 shares of its own common stock pursuant to a provision in the company's articles of incorporation under Japan's Companies Act Section 459(1)(1). The acquisition will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours trading) on 18 August 2026 at 08:45 JST, using the prior day's closing price of ¥1,098 per share. The total purchase amount shall not exceed ¥109,800,000. The order is valid only for the specified trading window; partial or complete non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be announced after the 08:45 window closes. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 298,808 treasury shares against 7,433,462 shares issued and outstanding (excluding treasury).
